meta.source: Starting values first observed in the Selvar demo (demo.codeandchill.store/selvar), used as a reference only. PmOps' CSS and components are its own. Roles follow PmOps spec v1.3.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the board. Never put body text directly on it in dense areas; use card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Default surface: cards, issue cards, drawers, dialogs, inputs, buttons (secondary).

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Recessed surface: board columns, hover on secondary buttons, kbd keys, table header rows.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Translucent inset: segmented-control track, ghost-button hover, selected row in the command palette.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline border on cards, columns, chips and dividers. 1px only.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger border: inputs, secondary buttons, kbd, empty-column dashed outline, progress track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on card, card-2 and bg (15:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta lines, column sums, labels. 5.4:1+ on every surface; the smallest text colour for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholder text, disabled labels. FLAG: 3.5–3.9:1 on light surfaces (below 4.5:1); use only for non-essential text or at 18px+, never for the only copy of information.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Inverted fill: the dark 'ink' button and toasts. Same value as text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue: primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected state, 'show more' links. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary fills (6.3:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar background in both themes (the sidebar stays dark).

tokens.name: side-top
tokens.usage: Sidebar header gradient top / raised sidebar surfaces.

tokens.name: on-side
tokens.usage: Primary text on the sidebar: hovered nav items, the workspace name.

tokens.name: side-dim
tokens.usage: Resting nav item text and icons on the sidebar (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: side-faint
tokens.usage: Sidebar group labels ('PLAN', 'TRACK'). FLAG: 3.9–4.4:1; uppercase 11px labels only, never actions.

tokens.name: side-hover
tokens.usage: Nav item hover fill on the sidebar.

tokens.name: side-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: side-pill
tokens.usage: Active nav item pill fill.

tokens.name: on-side-pill
tokens.usage: Text on the active nav pill.

tokens.name: side-pill-chip
tokens.usage: Count badge inside the active nav pill.

tokens.name: side-accent
tokens.usage: Icon colour of the active nav item.

tokens.name: c-amber
tokens.usage: Strong amber: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: In Progress category, Epic type. Dots must sit next to a text label (FLAG: under 3:1 on card in light).

tokens.name: c-cobalt
tokens.usage: Strong cobalt: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: Story type, selected chip, custom status colour. Dots must sit next to a text label.

tokens.name: c-sky
tokens.usage: Strong sky: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: To Do category, Sub-task type. Dots must sit next to a text label (FLAG: under 3:1 on card in light).

tokens.name: c-coral
tokens.usage: Strong coral: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: Bug type, High priority. Dots must sit next to a text label.

tokens.name: c-teal
tokens.usage: Strong teal: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: Spike type. Dots must sit next to a text label.

tokens.name: c-slate
tokens.usage: Strong slate: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: Task type, neutral tags. Dots must sit next to a text label.

tokens.name: c-sand
tokens.usage: Strong sand: status dots, type icons, chart series, the 14% (light) / 18% (dark) pill tint. PmOps role: Initiative type, low-signal tags. Dots must sit next to a text label (FLAG: under 3:1 on card in light).

tokens.name: t-amber
tokens.usage: Text in amber pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text in cobalt pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-sky
tokens.usage: Text in sky pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-coral
tokens.usage: Text in coral pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-teal
tokens.usage: Text in teal pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-slate
tokens.usage: Text in slate pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: t-sand
tokens.usage: Text in sand pills, chips and tags (5.3:1+ on its own tint in both themes).

tokens.name: c-good
tokens.usage: Signal: Done category, success, on-track. Fills for dots, icons, danger buttons and progress; tint at 14%/18% for pills.

tokens.name: t-good
tokens.usage: Text for the good signal on its tint.

tokens.name: c-warn
tokens.usage: Signal: At risk, due soon. Fills for dots, icons, danger buttons and progress; tint at 14%/18% for pills.

tokens.name: t-warn
tokens.usage: Text for the warn signal on its tint.

tokens.name: c-bad
tokens.usage: Signal: Blocked, overdue, Urgent priority, Incident type, destructive. Fills for dots, icons, danger buttons and progress; tint at 14%/18% for pills.

tokens.name: t-bad
tokens.usage: Text for the bad signal on its tint.

tokens.name: c-info
tokens.usage: Signal: Informational notices. Fills for dots, icons, danger buttons and progress; tint at 14%/18% for pills.

tokens.name: t-info
tokens.usage: Text for the info signal on its tint.

tokens.name: av-amber
tokens.usage: Avatar background (amber). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-amber-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-amber.

tokens.name: av-cobalt
tokens.usage: Avatar background (cobalt). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-cobalt-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-cobalt.

tokens.name: av-coral
tokens.usage: Avatar background (coral). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-coral-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-coral.

tokens.name: av-sand
tokens.usage: Avatar background (sand). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-sand-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-sand.

tokens.name: av-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar background (sky). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-sky-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-sky.

tokens.name: av-slate
tokens.usage: Avatar background (slate). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-slate-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-slate.

tokens.name: av-teal
tokens.usage: Avatar background (teal). Dark value is the strong colour at 30% over card. Assign per person by hashing their id, so a person keeps one colour.

tokens.name: av-teal-t
tokens.usage: Initials on av-teal.

tokens.name: tile-feature
tokens.usage: Featured KPI tile fill (one per dashboard).

tokens.name: on-feature
tokens.usage: Text on tile-feature.

tokens.name: tile-sky
tokens.usage: Soft highlight tile (secondary KPI, AI box, approval cards).

tokens.name: tile-butter
tokens.usage: Warm highlight tile (warnings summary, 'needs attention').

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Text on tile-sky and tile-butter.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles (Board, Backlog, My work). One per page.

styles.name: heading-3xl
styles.usage: Issue title in the drawer and dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The quick review caught a regression before release.

styles.name: text-md
styles.usage: Issue-card titles, buttons, nav items, column names, inputs.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, card subtitles, small buttons, chips, field labels (600).

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Pills, stepper labels, palette group labels.

styles.name: text-2xs
styles.usage: Issue keys, counts, kbd keys, sidebar group labels (uppercase).

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Segmented-control gap, tight icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in pills, stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Pill and chip internal gap, field label to input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between issue cards in a column; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Gap between board columns; nav item icon gap; column side padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Issue-card padding; chip and small-button side padding; column top padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The layout gap: between cards, sections and toolbar groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Drawer and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Max page gutter (gutter flexes 16–32px with the viewport).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: kbd keys, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and icon buttons (32px), segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-ctl
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, chips, palette rows, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Issue cards and toasts (16px).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: KPI tiles.

tokens.name: radius-col
tokens.usage: Board columns.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Drawers and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, counts, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Issue cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers: drawer, command palette, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: An issue card while it is being dragged.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: input-h
tokens.usage: Text inputs and selects; nav items.

tokens.name: pill-h
tokens.usage: Status and label pills.

tokens.name: side-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: side-w-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar rail width.

tokens.name: column-min-w
tokens.usage: Board column minimum width (columns flex to fill).

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Issue drawer width (viewport minus 24px on small screens).

tokens.name: palette-w
tokens.usage: Command palette width.

duration.note: Motion timings. Every duration becomes 0 when prefers-reduced-motion is set. Full rules: Motion section.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Hover fades, tooltip fade-out.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Page fade-out, palette close (160ms), drawer close (240ms).

tokens.name: dur-short
tokens.usage: Drag lift, toggle switch, card settle (320ms).

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Dialog in, list/row entrances, chart value changes up to 800ms.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Drawer in, nav sub-items unfold, sidebar collapse (600ms).

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Chart reveals and progress fills. Never for anything a person waits on.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a staggered list (20ms for long lists, 60ms for top-bar items).

easing.note: Curves for CSS transitions and Motion (motion/react). In Motion pass the four numbers as an array, e.g. ease: [.215, .61, .355, 1].

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: CSS transitions (hover, toggles, colour changes).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: rows, cards, page content.

tokens.name: ease-out-strong
tokens.usage: Drawers and sheets sliding in.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits: page fade-out, drawer and dialog close.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move between two resting places: sidebar collapse, progress fills.

tokens.name: ease-overshoot
tokens.usage: Small moments only: dialog in, nav icon pop. Never on board moves.
